items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: we did four weeks at the Tropicana Hotel with that band. And it was — we had, who else did we have on there, oh we had Mavis Rivers is the singer.

ctx.x: Oh well I’m sure he gave you a big raise for all that double duty.

No. Nothing. And he never said one complimentary word to me, not once ever. Not once ever. And it was just, we did four weeks at the Tropicana Hotel with that band. And it was — we had, who else did we have on there, oh we had Mavis Rivers is the singer. Remember her?
